text:
lara: Quick thread 1: we need a lightweight claim flow for SI co-sell + marketplace attribution. last weeks fight with ACME was messy. want a repeatable, automatable pattern.

diego: yes. proposal: introduce 3 claim tags on intake: ‘si_claim’, ‘rw_claim’, ‘joint_claim’. tags are set by SFDC ingest and partner portal.

nina: How do we validate ‘si_claim’? require one artifact: signed SOW, invoice, or customer email cc'ing SI within 30 days before opportunity open. list that in the intake modal.

ben: add priority for paid pilots: if SI pays or underwrites pilot cost and uploads purchase doc -> SI precedence. note this in rules.

lara: good. also need auto-assignment rules for marketplace orders lacking partner metadata. idea: if sku starts_with "partner_" OR checkout_ref contains partner_id -> ping ops and tag si_claim.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPS-8910: "marketplace attribution heuristics" assigned to ben. due 2024-07-20.

diego: for conflicts: 1) if both parties claim within 14 days, mark ‘joint_claim’ and require joint owner plan in SFDC; 2) if dispute >3 business days -> lock to earliest documented outreach and escalate to partnerships@redwood.com.

nina: small checklist for handoff to avoid ping-pong: - single doc summary (one paragraph), - named POC for SI and RW, - procurement owner, - next 2 actions and owners. keep it super short.

lara: can we add a minimal email template for ops to send when claims are assigned/locked so customers see clarity? something like: "Hi <buyer>, routing update: primary owner is <entity>. Next step: <X>."

ben: Ill prototype the SFDC intake fields. snippet idea: 
```
claim_origin: [redwood|si|marketplace]
claim_evidence_url: text
claim_evidence_type: [sow|invoice|email|portal_action]
claim_window_days: 14
primary_owner_id: user_id
locked_until: date
```

lara: nina + diego: can you two own the dispute playbook and the short email templates? target EOW Wednesday.

nina: yes. will draft and share by Tue 12pm PT.

diego: will wire the SFDC validation rules with ben.

legal-bot: Legal notif: please submit SLA language for claim locking to legal-review queue LR-554 by 2024-07-11.

lara: thanks. final asks: ben -> SFDC fields + ops ticket, nina -> dispute playbook + templates, diego -> validation rules + joint claim UX copy. I'll publish to partner portal once all pieces in. :raised_hands:

ben: ack. linking OPS-8910 when ready.

nina: adding one anonymized customer anecdote to the playbook (saved to examples doc).

diego: thumbs up.

lara: this should cut churn on handoffs. great work.
